title: Cross-team launch rehearsal and capacity stress-test slate for runtime/console/api
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: run a coordinated cross-functional dry-run that exercises the runtime, console, and API launch paths under realistic load and failure modes. Outcomes: validate cutover checklist, surface capacity and telemetry gaps, verify rollback triggers and communication channels, and produce an actionable remediation backlog. This ticket coordinates scheduling, scenario definitions, success criteria, and post-mortem actions with Eng, SRE, Design (console), and Support.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled dry-run window with stakeholders from Eng (runtime, infra), Console PM/Design, API product, SRE, Support, and Legal completed
A minimum of three predefined traffic scenarios executed: nominal ramp, flash-burst (2x expected peak), and partial-region outage with failover
All runbook steps executed and time-to-action metrics recorded for primary operators
At least one simulated rollback initiated and validated end-to-end (feature flags, routing, and customer communication templates)
Post-run report created with prioritized remediation items and owners assigned (severity-based)
Dashboards and alerting thresholds validated or updated based on observed metrics
tasks: Finalize rehearsal date and 4-hour window with regional teams
Draft three traffic scenarios and required test data (QA + synthetic clients)
Annotate runbook with explicit decision gates and rollback criteria
Provision temporary canary capacity for experiments (eng ops request ticket)
Schedule 30m pre-run alignment and 60m post-run debrief
Prepare communication templates for developer channels, customer-facing status, and exec brief
Hook up trace-id propagation and annotate Playbook for tracing across runtime -> console -> api
Create GitHub PRs for any short-lived feature-flag changes needed for rehearsal
Assign SRE to monitor and capture heap/latency/kv-cache hit-rate snapshots
